note: Subject texts of the Cultists of the Ancient Ones (beads pulp_wars-mch9.14 and pulp_wars-mch9.15, docs/art/factions/CULT.md). The faction has fixed colours and no owner colour: the lodge wears indigo cloth with pale cream wax and paper, warm brass and one accent, a bright green flame; the summoned are rubbery deep-sea teal with cream bellies and pale yellow eyes, and their colours are named here, never in the faction fragment. The Initiate, the Horror, the Herald and City 1 are the lines of the direction's first sample. The lines of the batches (bead pulp_wars-mch9.15) call the cloth a bright royal blue: PixelLab draws 'midnight indigo' as slate grey, and the cult-lodge accent step turns any saturated blue into the lodge's indigo. The Unbound lines, the ship lines and the frog document edits, which send only their instruction.

subjects.UNIT:CULT:FIGHTER: Subject: Initiate, a chunky cute small secret-society novice with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny round body lost in a robe too big for it: a tall pointed midnight indigo hood whose tip flops over to one side, the face hidden in the hood's dark opening except two big round cream-white eyes, a long bell-shaped midnight indigo robe with a neat round hem down to the ground and sleeves too long for the arms, a fat pale cream wax candle with a small bright green flame held up in one hand, a sheaf of pale cream paper pamphlets tucked under the other arm, a small brass badge on the chest, pale cream slippers peeking out under the hem; no weapon, no staff, no beard, no skull; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:HORROR: Subject: Horror, a chunky cute round rubbery monster, clearly bigger than a soldier, a ball on legs: one big round smooth deep-sea teal body with a pale cream belly, standing on four short thick teal tentacles with pale cream suckers, a very wide happy grin full of small blunt cream teeth, two big round googly pale yellow eyes of different sizes with black pupils, a brass spiked collar round its middle with a short brass chain trailing behind; no arms, no clothes, no hood, no cloth, no horns, no claws; the tentacle feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a silly friendly monster, not scary; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:HERALD: Subject: Herald, a chunky cute towering herald, a giant much taller than a normal soldier and narrow, filling the whole height of the image: a tall tapering bell-shaped robe of midnight indigo cloth sprinkled with a few small pale cream stars, reaching the ground with a neat round hem, long empty hanging sleeves, a brass collar ring, and in place of a head one huge round pale yellow eye with a black pupil under a crown of five short thick curling deep-sea teal tentacles with pale cream suckers; no face, no mouth, no hands, no feet, no weapon; the robe's hem is the lowest thing in the image; pompous and silly, not scary; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:HORROR_UNBOUND: Subject: Unbound Horror, the Horror with its chain snapped: the same round rubbery deep-sea teal ball on four tentacles with the same wide grin, its two big round eyes glowing red, its brass spiked collar cracked and no chain behind it; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:HERALD_UNBOUND: Subject: Unbound Herald, the Herald with its binding broken: the same tall bell-shaped starry indigo robe and crown of teal tentacles, its one huge round eye glowing red, its brass collar ring cracked open; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:GUARD: Subject: Idol Bearer, a chunky cute stout wide secret-society member with a huge round head, the widest and squarest of its kind: a short bright royal blue hood squashed flat on top, the face hidden in the hood's dark opening except two big round cream-white eyes, a wide bell-shaped bright royal blue robe with a neat round hem down to the ground, pale cream slippers; both short arms straight up holding one squat grinning pale grey stone idol head with two small bright green eyes over its own head, the idol as big as the head under it, like two heads stacked; one figure only; no weapon, no staff, no beard, no skull; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:RAIDER: Subject: Familiar, a chunky cute fat toad-cat, a small low wide pet animal in mid-hop: a round squat body with a smooth bright royal blue hide and a pale cream belly, two short pointed cat ears, two stubby little blue bat wings on its back, one big round cream-white eye and one small one with black pupils, a wide closed happy mouth, four short stubby legs, a brass collar with a small round brass bell; wider than it is tall; the feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a silly pet, not scary; simple shapes and very few details.

subjects.UNIT:CULT:CAPTAIN: Subject: Summoner, a chunky cute tall thin secret-society master, the tallest and thinnest of its kind: a very tall straight pointed bright royal blue hat-hood, as tall again as the body, that reaches the top of the image, the face hidden in the hood's dark opening except two big round cream-white eyes, a long narrow bright royal blue robe with a neat round hem down to the ground, a long pale cream stole hanging round the neck, pale cream slippers; a small brass hand bell raised in one hand and a looped brass chain hanging from the other; no weapon, no staff, no beard, no skull; simple shapes and very few details.

subjects.UNIT:CULT:TENTACLE: Subject: Tentacle, one chunky cute thick rubbery deep-sea teal tentacle rising straight up from the bottom edge of the image and curled over at the top as if to slap, a row of round pale cream suckers down its inner side, one round pale yellow eye with a black pupil at its tip; nothing else: no body, no hole, no water, no ground; the cut base of the tentacle is the lowest thing in the image; silly, not scary; simple shapes and very few details.
